Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the hierarchy within the information available and concluded incorrectly that Concepción Sáenz de Tejada y Fernández de Bobadilla was the maternal grandmother instead of Queen Sofía of Spain. This mistake arose from a misunderstanding of the family tree structure. The Planner relied on an alignment of grandparent pairs without thoroughly verifying with clear genealogical sources, leading to a logical error when aligning Concepción Sáenz with the wrong side of the family. The error was reinforced by not effectively prioritizing credible genealogical evidence and failing to reconcile this conclusion with previously gathered knowledge.
